parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc`: descending order.

- `asc`: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SelfOnly
parameters.description: If true, retrieves resource usage from the current quota only.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- QuotaId

- SubmittedCPU

- SubmittedMemory

- SubmittedGPU

- UsedCPU

- UsedMemory

- UsedGPU

- WorkloadCount

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Filters the results by user ID.
